prompts.title: Review an SSE endpoint
prompts.description: Checks a server-sent-events route for resume support, headers and heartbeats, then reports a pass/fail checklist.
prompts.author: lpcooper-arch

versions.author: lpcooper-arch
versions.summary: First cut from the ADR-0006 review
versions.body:
Review the SSE endpoint `{{endpoint}}` in `{{router_file}}`.

Check:
- The response is `text/event-stream` with `Cache-Control: no-cache`.
- Every event carries an `id:` so the client can resume.
- The generator closes cleanly when the client disconnects.

Report findings as a checklist.

versions.author: lpcooper-arch
versions.body:
Review the SSE endpoint `{{endpoint}}` in `{{router_file}}`.

Check:
- The response is `text/event-stream` with `Cache-Control: no-cache`.
- Every event carries an `id:` so the client can resume.
- The generator closes cleanly when the client disconnects.
- Heartbeat comments (`: ping`) go out at least every 15s so Cloudflare does not drop the stream.

Report findings as a checklist.

versions.author: Jose-Gael-Cruz-Lopez
versions.body:
Review the SSE endpoint `{{endpoint}}` in `{{router_file}}`.

Check:
- The response is `text/event-stream` with `Cache-Control: no-cache`.
- Every event carries an `id:` so the client can resume.
- The generator closes cleanly when the client disconnects.
- Heartbeat comments (`: ping`) go out at least every 15s so Cloudflare does not drop the stream.

Then read the client in `{{client_file}}` and confirm it sends `Last-Event-ID` on reconnect.

Report findings as a checklist, one line per check, marked pass / fail / n/a.

prompts.title: Reconcile a session before record_session
prompts.description: Run before record_session. Reconciles what actually shipped against the docs so the feed and proposals match reality.
prompts.author: AndresL230

versions.author: AndresL230
versions.body:
Before calling `record_session`, reconcile what actually shipped in `{{repo}}` since {{since}}.

1. Run `git log --oneline {{since}}..HEAD` and `gh pr list --state merged --search "merged:>={{since}}"`.
2. For each doc you plan to touch, `get_doc` it first and diff against the live version.
3. Draft one feed entry per shipped change.

versions.author: AndresL230
versions.summary: Link PRs, route unplaced items to triage
versions.body:

4. Anything you can't place in a section goes to `needs_triage` with a one-line reason.

prompts.title: Harden a Gemini agent prompt
prompts.description: Tightens a Gemini agent's system prompt against known failure examples without changing its output schema.
prompts.author: Jose-Gael-Cruz-Lopez

versions.author: Jose-Gael-Cruz-Lopez
versions.summary: Staged by a session on fix/quiz-agent-json
versions.body:
Harden the system prompt in `{{agent_file}}` against these failures:

{{failure_examples}}

- Keep the Pydantic AI output schema unchanged.
- Add at most two few-shot examples.
- Route through `services/gemini_service.py`; never call the SDK directly.

Show the before/after prompt and which failure each change addresses.

prompts.title: Review a Supabase migration
prompts.description: Pre-flight review for a Supabase migration: RLS, defaults, concurrent indexes and lock duration.
prompts.author: lpcooper-arch

versions.author: lpcooper-arch
versions.body:
Review `{{migration_file}}` before it runs against production.

- `{{table}}` has RLS enabled and a policy per role.
- New columns are nullable or have a default.

versions.author: lpcooper-arch
versions.body:
Review `{{migration_file}}` before it runs against production.

- `{{table}}` has RLS enabled and a policy per role.
- New columns are nullable or have a default.
- Indexes on large tables are created `CONCURRENTLY`.
- Nothing takes an `ACCESS EXCLUSIVE` lock for longer than a second.

prompts.title: Triage an OCR pipeline failure
prompts.description: Decides whether a failed OCR job hit quota, a timeout or a bad PDF, and what to do next.
prompts.author: Jose-Gael-Cruz-Lopez

versions.author: Jose-Gael-Cruz-Lopez
versions.body:
Triage OCR job `{{job_id}}` ({{pdf_pages}} pages).

1. Pull the job row from `document_jobs` and its DBOS workflow status.
2. Decide: quota, timeout, or malformed PDF.
3. If quota, do not retry. Post the job id to the feed tagged `infra`.
